load_bearing_race_fix.problem: Concurrent adopt_mission / append_receipt read-modify-write of the adoption and receipt hash-chains was guarded only by atomic_write (last-writer-wins) with no lock. Two concurrent adoptions could produce two git commits but a single surviving chain record (a governed state change with no receipt), or fail on git index.lock contention.
load_bearing_race_fix.fix: GovernedWriteLock (production.rs): flock(LOCK_EX) advisory lock on <home>/.governed-write.lock, held across the whole load->verify->commit->append critical section; serializes threads in one process and multiple app instances sharing a home. Acquired in state_repo::adopt_mission and rails::append_receipt. No re-entrancy (they never nest), so a single owned flock cannot self-deadlock.
